utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please put my name down—I can help if you still need someone on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Absolutely — I’ll add your name to Saturday and check the list for any remaining tool needs.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Dane — I appreciate it. If you hear of any tool gaps, let me know and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can take the signups and help round up supplies—just point me to whichever’s most urgent for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Mara — the most urgent thing is supplies, and the signups can follow right after. If you can start with that, I’ll keep track of who still needs help near Maple and 3rd.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Got it — I’ll start on supplies right away and keep you posted. If you hear of anything specific that’s still needed near Maple and 3rd, send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Noah — I’ll have the hammer and screwdriver ready for you. Just swing by when you can.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — I’ll come by when I can and grab them.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem, Noah — glad to help. Just come by whenever you’re ready, and I’ll have them set aside.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — 10 at the community shed, right? I’ll be there, and I’m happy to help sort the tools if you still need me.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — 10 at the community shed, and I’ll remind you again before then. Thanks, Oren; your help with the tools will be great.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — that reminder will help a lot. I’ll be there at 10 and ready to sort the tools.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Kira — I’ll keep track of the supplies and let you know what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yep — 9 a.m. works. See you then for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks Kira — I’ll keep an eye on the supplies list and update you if anything’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll bring you the details and keep you posted. If it looks like a fit, I can add your name later.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Ira — that helps a lot. I’ll get the details to you soon, and feel free to point anyone my way who wants in.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can do sorting and box-carrying again. Just point me where to start when people arrive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’d be a huge help, Leo — I’m mainly trying to keep the drop-off line moving and make sure the boxes don’t pile up near the side entrance.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll take the boxes by the side entrance and keep them moving out of the line.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s still moving along nicely—people are signing up, and I’m helping match volunteers to the right repair jobs. If you know anyone who wants to help, I’m happy to loop them in.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds great—could you also let me know who’s already signed up and whether we still need gloves or screwdrivers?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can check who’s signed up and pass along the tool needs—thanks for keeping an eye out. If you hear of anyone with gloves or screwdrivers, I’d love to loop them in too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Rey — I’ll keep you in the loop and slot you in where it’s most needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Rosa — that sounds good. Just let me know where I should start, and I’ll help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — I’ll put you on setup and check-in when folks start arriving. I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, Saturday morning at the community hall, and you can drop donations off by the side entrance. If you want, I can also pass along what kinds of items they’re looking for.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess — I’d appreciate that. Just send me the list, and I’ll see if I can bring something by Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — they said they could use clean blankets, canned goods, and gently used coats. I’ll let you know if I hear any more specifics.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yep, I’m still in — I’ll be there around 2. Do you want me to bring any tools or supplies?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, please bring any basic hand tools you have, and I’ll keep the rest on a simple list. 2 o’clock works fine—I’ll see you then.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and keep it aligned with the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, still good to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great — thanks, Bo. Just let me know what you’d like me to do next.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Could you point me to the donation pile and flyer stack? I’ll take it from there after school.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Kira — I’m spreading the word about the repair drive. Want me to bring you the details or put your name down?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yes—please put me down, and send me the details too. Just confirm you’ll be there on Saturday to help load the donations, and I’ll take it from there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ve got you down, and I’ll send the details over too. Yes, I’ll be there Saturday to help load the donations.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, I’m still planning to mention it while I’m out today. If you can make it around 2, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll spread the word and be there around 2. Thanks for mentioning it while you’re out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks Vik — I really appreciate it. See you around 2!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds fine, Rey. Keep it simple and I’ll stop by at the usual time.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’ll keep it simple and be there at the usual time.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, that works for me. I’ll see you then at the usual time.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, right — thanks for keeping me in the loop. I can help with the small stuff, just remind me where you need me most.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Hana — if you can help after school, that’d be perfect. I’ll send the school times and the tricky windows so we can place you where it fits best.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — send me the school times and the tricky windows, and I’ll check where I fit best after school.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please put my name down—I can help on Saturday if you still need someone.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Absolutely, Nell — I’ll put you down for Saturday. Thanks, that helps a lot.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Glad to help — what kind of job should I expect on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s coming along nicely—people are still signing up, and we’re trying to match folks with the right jobs. If you’ve heard of anyone who wants to help, I’d be happy to loop them in.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good—I’ll keep an eye out and send anyone your way who wants to help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Dane — I really appreciate it, and I’ll keep matching folks up as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—lamps, tools, and appliances that still work a bit. I can bring whatever I find around here.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s helpful, thanks. So it’s Saturday morning at the community hall, by the side entrance, right?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—yes, Saturday morning at the community hall, by the side entrance. Thanks for the reminder.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Leo, could you help move the donation boxes from the community center to the repair shed on Pine Street?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I can help move the boxes over to the repair shed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Leo — could you take them from the community center over to the repair shed on Pine Street?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam — I’d appreciate the details when you have a moment. I’m still unsure, but I’d like to take a look.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can do that. I’ll pick up the donation boxes at the community center and drop them off at the repair shed on Pine Street.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. That helps — I’ll look over the details once you bring them by.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep — Saturday morning at the community hall, with donations going in by the side entrance. If you want, I can also keep an ear out for any updates on what they’re especially needing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That’d be great—please keep me posted on what they need most. I can help spread the word and bring a few supplies if you send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll keep my ears open and pass along anything I hear. Thanks for helping spread the word, Mina!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — thanks for the reminder. I’m ready to help sort the donated tools and figure out what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren — that’d be a big help. I’ll keep the supply list updated, and we can sort out the gaps together.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good — I’ll start with the donated tools and help spot anything missing. If you’ve got the list handy, I can compare it as we go.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can help with tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need, Mara.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — tools would be a big help. If you can bring them together, I’ll handle the signups and keep the repair drive organized.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Mara — I’ll gather a few useful tools and bring them by for the repair drive.
